notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome connector only, own tab, no HTTP/proxy route used. DOMAIN: the roster domain hk-living.com is a dead LeaseWeb parked domain (documented in the prior Home-Decor pass); the real live HKLIVING brand site is hkliving.com and that is what was extracted, so links carry the no-dash domain. robots.txt on www.hkliving.com returns a browser error page (no robots.txt exists) -> no Claude-specific or blanket disallow applies. TREE: taken from the site's own mega-menu on the homepage and re-confirmed on each department page. Departments: Sofas, Furniture, Kitchen, Textile, Lighting, Accessories, Outdoor, Art, Brand kit, Add ons. Furniture-bearing departments are Sofas (6 model sub-categories), Furniture (7 sub-categories), Outdoor (Outdoor furniture) plus one stray node, Accessories > Clothing racks. COUNTS: HKLIVING renders its own product total in a <span class="totalcount"> next to the 'SHOW PRODUCTS N / FILTER PRODUCTS' control on every listing page. This is the rendered listing header (QTY method 1). Static HTML alone shows only 'Loading filter please wait...' (confirmed by a same-origin fetch), so every count here was read from a fully rendered page - either by navigating my tab to the URL, or by loading the URL in a same-origin hidden iframe inside my own tab and polling until .totalcount was populated. No HTTP client, no external endpoint, no tile/href counting was used. SANITY CHECKS: (a) counts vary per category (1 to 30), no constant site-wide number; (b) the 7 Furniture children sum to 11+29+10+13+14+30+7 = 114, exactly the Furniture department's own totalcount of 114; (c) the 6 Sofas children sum to 8+18+11+9+1+4 = 51, exactly the Sofas department's own totalcount of 51. Two independent exact reconciliations, so the totalcount field is per-category and exact, not inflated; (d) document.title / breadcrumb was checked on every page to confirm the loaded page is the category requested (no silent parent fallback). Nomad couch renders the generic site title but its breadcrumb reads Sofas > Nomad couch and its 8 is required by the 51 reconciliation. DEEPEST-URL RULE: Sofas, Furniture and Outdoor are emitted as grouping rows only; their children carry the qty+URL. Outdoor furniture and every Furniture/Sofas child have no further children (checked on-page), so they are leaves. EXCLUDED: Kitchen (ceramics/tableware/glassware/cutlery/kitchen accessories/serveware/table linen), Textile (bath mats, bed linen, cushions, rugs, wall rugs, towels & robes), Lighting (all), Accessories except clothing racks (clocks, candle holders, home fragrances, flowerpots, mirrors, objects & sculptures, vases, wall decoration, lookbooks), Art, Outdoor textile, Outdoor accessories (textiles/parasols/decor), Brand kit, and the 'All Products' / 'Fresh stock' / 'Collections' navigation nodes per section 3. 'Add ons' is behind a dealer login (navigating to /products/add-ons/ serves the HKLIVING login page, no totalcount) and in any case holds sofa add-on parts, which are excluded as furniture parts; nothing was lost from scope. No beds, desks, wardrobes, office or bathroom furniture exist in this catalogue.
